def render(messages, width=12):
    lines = ["=" * 34]
    for i, m in enumerate(messages, 1):
        content = m["content"]
        preview = content[:width] + ("…" if len(content) > width else "")
        lines.append(f"{i:02d} [{m['role']:<9}] {preview}")

    return "\n".join(lines)

title: 工具结果缓存
description: 相同参数的工具调用直接命中缓存
full_code:
class CachedTool:
    def __init__(self, fn):
        self.fn = fn
        self.cache = {}
        self.real_calls = 0

    def __call__(self, **kwargs):
        key = tuple(sorted(kwargs.items()))
        if key in self.cache:
            return self.cache[key], True
        self.real_calls += 1
        self.cache[key] = self.fn(**kwargs)
        return self.cache[key], False

weather = CachedTool(lambda city: f"{city} 晴")

r1, hit1 = weather(city="北京")
r2, hit2 = weather(city="北京")
r3, hit3 = weather(city="上海")
print(f"北京: {r1} (命中={hit1})")
print(f"北京再次: {r2} (命中={hit2})")
print(f"上海: {r3} (命中={hit3}) | 实际调用: {weather.real_calls}")
expected:
北京: 北京 晴 (命中=False)
北京再次: 北京 晴 (命中=True)
上海: 上海 晴 (命中=False) | 实际调用: 2

title: ReAct Agent
description: 实现完整的 思考-行动-观察 循环直到最终答案
full_code:
import re

TOOLS = {
    "search": lambda q: f"找到资料: {q} 是会用工具的 AI 程序",
    "calculator": lambda expr: "42",
}

llm_script = [
    "Thought: 我需要先搜索 Agent 的定义\nAction: search[什么是 agent]",
    "Thought: 资料够了\nFinal Answer: Agent 是会用工具的 AI 程序",
]

messages = ["用户问题: 什么是 agent"]
for step in range(5):
    reply = llm_script.pop(0)
    final = re.search(r"Final Answer: (.+)", reply)
    if final:
        print("最终答案:", final.group(1))
        break
    action = re.search(r"Action: (\w+)\[(.+?)\]", reply)
    name, arg = action.group(1), action.group(2)
    observation = TOOLS[name](arg)
    messages.append(f"{reply}\nObservation: {observation}")
    print(f"第 {step + 1} 步: {name}({arg}) -> {observation}")
expected:
第 1 步: search(什么是 agent) -> 找到资料: 什么是 agent 是会用工具的 AI 程序
最终答案: Agent 是会用工具的 AI 程序

class TaskRunner:
    """按队列执行任务，失败的任务重新排队一次。"""

    def __init__(self, tasks):
        self.pending = list(tasks)
        self.done = []

    def run_all(self, retries):
        while self.pending:
            task = self.pending.pop(0)
            if retries.get(task, 0) > 0:
                retries[task] -= 1
                self.pending.append(task)
                print(f"失败，重新排队: {task}")
                continue
            self.done.append(task)
            print(f"完成: {task}")

runner = TaskRunner(["收集资料", "撰写初稿", "校对格式"])
runner.run_all({"撰写初稿": 1})
print("完成:", runner.done)

完成: 收集资料
失败，重新排队: 撰写初稿
完成: 校对格式
完成: 撰写初稿

title: 重叠切块
description: 按块大小与重叠度切分长文档
full_code:
class Chunker:
    """按块大小与重叠度切分长文档。"""

    def __init__(self, size=5, overlap=2):
        self.size = size
        self.overlap = overlap

    def split(self, text):
        stride = self.size - self.overlap
        chunks = []
        for i in range(0, max(1, len(text) - self.overlap), stride):
            chunks.append(text[i:i + self.size])
        return chunks

doc = "Agent能够自主决策并调用工具完成多步任务"
chunker = Chunker(size=6, overlap=2)
chunks = chunker.split(doc)
for i, c in enumerate(chunks, 1):
    print(f"块{i}: [{c}]")
cover = sum(len(c) - chunker.overlap for c in chunks[:-1]) + len(chunks[-1])
print("总字符覆盖:", cover, "/ 原文:", len(doc))

块2: [t能够自主决]

总字符覆盖: 22 / 原文: 22
